abstract: Covers Internet X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Certificate and Certificate Revocation List (CRL) Profile. RFC 5280 Internet X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Certificate and Certificate Revocation List (CRL) Profile is current; RFC 6960 X.509 Internet Public Key Infrastructure Online Certificate Status Protocol - OCSP is current; RFC 9162 Certificate Transparency Version 2.0 is current; RFC 6962 Certificate Transparency is legacy. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
